assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The official SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons are not yet publicly released. All geometry, area calculations, and derived metrics are based on provisional boundaries and must be recalculated upon receipt of official data.
assumptions.impact: Area ratios, spatial relationships, and project locations are discussable but not precise. All figures and HTML visualizations carry provisional disclaimers.

assumptions.statement: The exact heritage protection boundary for Qinghuayuan Station and surrounding cultural resources is pending confirmation by heritage authorities.
assumptions.impact: Proposed cultural plaza, exhibition, and building renovation near the station are conceptual and require heritage review before implementation.

assumptions.statement: Rail line alignments and station TOD integration boundaries are indicative and must be confirmed by rail and planning authorities.
assumptions.impact: Transit-oriented design proposals are conceptual and subject to rail engineering and safety review.

assumptions.statement: Municipal pipeline, energy, drainage, flood control, and fire engineering data are not available.
assumptions.impact: Infrastructure proposals are conceptual prototypes; formal engineering feasibility study is required before construction.

assumptions.statement: Naming, logo concepts, visual identity, event branding, and any corporate logos or portraits referenced in scenarios require intellectual property clearance.
assumptions.impact: All brand elements in this submission are conceptual drafts and must be cleared before public use.
